name: Chilly Cow 66
author: watchakorn-18k
description: Neon gradient rounded indigo button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes 0 0 20px #743ad5, text color changes from #ffffff to #ffffff, text-shadow becomes 1px 1px 10px #d53a9d.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Chilly Cow 66</title>
<style>
/* Chilly Cow 66 by watchakorn-18k — https://uiverse.io/watchakorn-18k/chilly-cow-66 */
.btn-space {
  padding: 15px 45px;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  -webkit-transition: 0.5s;
  transition: 0.5s;
  background-size: 500% auto;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.103);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.btn-space:hover {
  background-position: right center;
  border-image-source: linear-gradient(90deg, #d53a9d,#743ad5 );
  -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 20px #743ad5;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px #743ad5;
  color: rgb(255, 255, 255);
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 10px #d53a9d;
}

.space {
  background-image: -webkit-gradient(linear, left top, right top, from(#743ad5), color-stop(51%, #d53a9d), to(#743ad5));
  background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #743ad5 0%, #d53a9d 51%, #743ad5 100%);
  border-image-source: linear-gradient(45deg, #743ad5, #d53a9d );
  border-image-outset: 1em;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn-space space">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
